Named for the warrior monk who held a bridge alone and died on his feet. Benkeis are the first Arasaka most of Night City has seen in half a century: they stand the Waterfront gates in black, and Synced Reflexes make a squad move like one guard. Arasaka wanted a body that says the company has come back and doesn't plan to leave. It works.

Cost: 39,300eb (Super Luxury)
Humanity Loss: 77 (23d6)
Frame: Omega (16): BODY 16
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Chrome: Anti-Dazzle ×2, FBC EMP Coating ×2, Heavy Subdermal Plating, Internal Hydraulics Upgrade (Tuned), Low Light/Infrared/UV ×2, ProxiShield ×2, Reinforced Cyberlimb Upgrade ×2, Subdermal Grip ×2, Synced Reflexes, Targeting Scope

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Drop it on a character (as GM) to install it with Go Metal.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
